Interface SettingInput

All Known Implementing Classes:
SettingInput.Choice, SettingInput.Numeric, SettingInput.Selection, SettingInput.Text, SettingInput.Toggle
public sealed interface SettingInput permits SettingInput.Choice, SettingInput.Toggle, SettingInput.Numeric, SettingInput.Text, SettingInput.Selection
An input the dialog editor shows for one argument of a SettingProvider.

The values entered are turned back into the argument tokens the provider parses, in the order the inputs are declared. Labels and option names may be locale codes.
